title: The atmospheric-neutrino floor in the extended window: CEvNS rates, spectral shape and uncertainty at 55-420 keV in xenon, and whether it limits the decisive tests
question: What atmospheric (and DSNB/solar) CEvNS rate, shape and uncertainty does the 55-420 keV xenon window face, and does it limit the modulation (P034), 10-100 t yr (P050) and untouched-exposure (P069) tests?
headline_result: Anchored to LZ's 0.11 Table I events, atmospheric CEvNS gives 3.1e-5 (Helm; 4.3e-6 shell model) events/(t yr) in 200-270 keV and 1.2e-5 in 270-420 keV, one event only at ~3e4 t yr; it first alters a 3 sigma discovery at 43 (200-270) / 31 t yr (200-420 keV) whereas all NR-band backgrounds do so at 6.7 / 1.1 t yr; the systematic floor is 1e-4-4e-4 of LZ's best-fit coupling, so the P034/P050/P069 tests are not neutrino-limited
key_numbers: recalled flux predicts 0.081 (0.067-0.089) vs Table I 0.11+-0.02, anchor x1.36; turn-on sigma 0.74 keV from 8B+hep 0.057; per t yr Helm/shell: 55-125 keV 6.8/5.8e-4, 125-200 2.3/0.8e-4, 200-270 3.1/0.43e-5, 270-420 1.2/0.83e-5; 200-270 per 2.84 t yr 8.9e-5 (shapes 4.6-10.6e-5; P019 6.5e-5); F^2 nodes 279/265/245 keV, x7 spread at 200-270, x1.4 at 270-420; DSNB <=1e-5/t yr above 55 keV; N_3sigma shape 5 (d366, 200-420) / 52 (LZ window) / ~2000 (d300); modulation 2% vs a1 0.43-1.66 (N_3sigma 45000 vs 5-97)
model_or_mechanism: atmospheric-neutrino CEvNS floor (Helm, Helm+skin, WimPyDD shell-model form factors) vs isoscalar O1 inelastic DM (1 TeV, delta 300/350/366 keV) and L10
result_type: computed (spectra, counts, discovery limits, KL) / estimated (recalled flux shape, modulation amplitude)
confidence: high - normalisation is LZ's own; conclusions survive the x7 form-factor and x2 flux-shape brackets
builds_on: LZ Table I/Discussion; P060, P019, P050, P069, P034, P016, P038, P021, P009
